description: This file defines classes and methods related to HR management, including timesheet groups, employee categories, employees, and timesheet lines, for an OpenERP (Odoo) module.

classes.name: hr_timesheet_group
classes.description: Represents a group of timesheets with methods to calculate time intervals.

classes.name: hr_employee_category
classes.description: Represents employee categories with hierarchical constraints.

classes.name: hr_employee
classes.description: Represents an employee with hierarchical constraints and personal details.

methods.name: interval_min_get
methods.description: Calculates minimum time intervals based on hours and timesheet group.

methods.name: interval_get
methods.description: Calculates time intervals based on hours and timesheet group.

methods.name: _check_recursion
methods.description: Checks for recursive parent-child relationships in categories or employees.
